messages:
mike: Heads-up — APAC customers are pushing for region-specific egress caps and a small onramp discount for the first 3 months. Need a quick take on feasibility and launch knobs.

anya: Context: two pilot customers (CloudHub AP and RetailCo JP) said region egress fees are blocking adoption. They want a per-region cap that can be attached to an existing commit.

li: Technical: we can tag usage by region and apply a cap/waiver at billing time. Main infra work is adding per-region commit objects and adapting the metering pipeline. Estimate 2 sprints for a minimal path.

carol: Product POV: Offer shape ideas: (A) regional cap as an add-on (billed monthly) (B) 90-day onramp discount that reduces egress price by 30% for that region. Both have different revenue impacts.

ben: Finance: onramp discount ok if we require commit or minimum ARR. Without commit it becomes abuse-prone. Suggest require 3mo minimum commit or net-new revenue floor.

mike: Sales asks: make it self-serve in console for pilots, with checkbox "APAC onramp" so we can convert quickly. Also request a manual override for strategic deals.

li: For self-serve we need API + console flags. Proposed API: POST /v1/accounts/{id}/region_caps body: { "region": "ap-northeast-1", "cap_gb": 1000, "discount_pct": 30, "duration_days": 90 }

carol: Add launch criteria: 1) infra KPI: billing pipeline error rate < 0.1% on synthetic load 2) UX: console flow validated by sales for pilot 3) legal signoff on contract language for region caps/discounts.

anya: Also require telemetry: discount_usage_pct, cap_breaches, regional_mrr_delta. Sales needs dashboard.

ben: Financial guardrails: cap_breaches > 10% of customers in pilot => pause rollout. Also require modeled impact < 5% ARR churn risk. I'll run sims.

mike: Legal note from Janet earlier: we need localized tax/effective date language. @sales-bot open CL for legal to review contract template.

sales-bot: Ticket created: https://tickets.internal/PRD-789 (assign: carol).

li: Ops note: need migration plan for existing accounts that already have region tagging. Propose opt-in grandfathering.

carol: Decision proposal: pilot release to 3 accounts with self-serve console + manual override. Onramp discount requires 3mo commit or MRR floor. Launch gated on telemetry + finance sims.

mike: Agree. Action items: li -> infra design doc by Thu, carol -> UX mocks + contract template, ben -> P&L sims by Fri, anya -> list pilot accounts and enablement notes.

anya: I'll ping CloudHub and RetailCo today.

mike: Thanks all :thumbsup:
